notable.headline: US Consumer Prices Rise 0.4% in October, Exceeding Forecasts as Fed Hike Looms
notable.read: The hard rates datum of the week. Headline +0.4% and core +0.3% both beat; markets price a 99% chance of a December 9 hike (a pre-CPI headline had 82.2%). Hits TLT, IEF, BND, VNQ and GLD as a group and long-duration tech. Continues the hawkish-hold, 10-year near 5% and PCE 3.6% thread; last week's 165K payrolls beat already pushed hike odds up. The bond price reaction is not in this input.

MSCI crypto-treasury decision on 11-11 is the next dated catalyst. Cowen's 'bottom in December' call is an opinion.
